name: UNFOLD
description: An uncompromising identity for a design publication. Folded paper geometry, bright yellow, and dense display typography turn the printed page into a graphic object.
heading: archivo
rules: Fold lines remain visible and meet at exact corners.
Run headlines across the page while captions stay in fixed columns.
Use yellow to designate primary editorial content, not decorative accents.

system.concept: Folded yellow paper, editorial crop marks, interlocking typographic planes, and full-bleed reading layouts. A publication that treats the page as both content and object.
headline: A different page.
A wider perspective.
system.productNote: A publication with an open fold.
features: Perspectives that make a familiar subject feel newly interesting.
Editorial design that gives each story a useful form.
A publication that leaves room for the next point of view.
system.layoutNote: Yellow poster hero, bold condensed editorial setting, exposed fold graphic, hard black rules, and square issue cards. Metadata always snaps to the grid.
